pitch: A night-shift barista who can hear electricity

hero.name: Juno

ability.name: Hear the Current
ability.text: Press an ear to any wire and hear what it carries.

hero.flaw: Tells everyone how each outlet is feeling, mid-sentence.
hero.roast: Juno can hear electricity. She has never once heard a customer's order.

visual.anchor: a tall skinny cartoon barista woman with an oversized round head, huge cupped ears, wild static-frizzed hair standing on end, dark under-eye circles, apron over a hoodie
visual.outfit: mint green apron over a striped hoodie, blank name tag

pitch: A raccoon who works security at the mall

hero.name: Gus

ability.name: Trash Sense
ability.text: Find anything anyone threw away nearby, in seconds.

hero.flaw: Abandons any post for a dropped pretzel.
hero.roast: Gus takes this job very seriously. The mall never technically hired him.

visual.anchor: a chubby cartoon raccoon standing upright, black bandit mask face, big striped tail, oversized security cap slipping over one eye, rumpled uniform two sizes too big
visual.outfit: baggy navy security uniform with a blank badge
visual.prop: a huge flashlight and half a pretzel

pitch: A grandma who's been a ghost hunter since 1974

hero.name: Dolores

ability.name: Stern Talking-To
ability.text: Scold any ghost until it apologizes and sits down.

hero.flaw: Refuses to touch any gadget invented after 1974.
hero.roast: Dolores has caught forty-one ghosts. She has never once answered a text.

visual.anchor: a tiny round cartoon grandma with a giant puffy white bouffant, enormous round glasses, a cardigan with far too many pockets, bright white sneakers
visual.outfit: lavender cardigan, plaid skirt, chunky white sneakers
visual.prop: a clunky vintage brass ghost detector

pitch: A substitute teacher who is secretly a cryptid

hero.name: Mr. Pruitt

ability.name: Go Blurry
ability.text: Turn so blurry that nobody can get a clear look.

hero.flaw: Is seven feet tall and furry, and insists he isn't.
hero.roast: Mr. Pruitt is a normal human teacher. Please stop photographing him.

visual.anchor: a towering lanky cartoon cryptid with shaggy brown fur, a huge gentle face with tiny reading glasses, very long arms, wearing a sweater vest that is far too small
visual.outfit: tight mustard sweater vest, crooked tie, corduroy slacks
visual.prop: a tall stack of ungraded papers

pitch: An influencer whose phone sees the future, badly

hero.name: Kai

ability.name: Sneak Preview
ability.text: Check your phone for a blurry clip of what happens next.

hero.flaw: Cannot do anything important without filming it first.
hero.roast: Kai's phone sees the future. It's mostly vertical video of Kai tripping.

visual.anchor: a bouncy cartoon young person with a giant swoop of pink hair, huge sparkly eyes, a round ring light glowing behind their head, an oversized puffer jacket
visual.outfit: oversized lilac puffer jacket, chunky platform sneakers
visual.prop: a phone with a blank glowing screen

pitch: A crossing guard who can stop time for exactly 3 seconds

hero.name: Bev

ability.name: Hold It Right There
ability.text: Raise your paddle and freeze time for exactly three seconds.

hero.flaw: Spends two of the three seconds deciding what to do.
hero.roast: Bev can stop time. She mostly uses it to finish her sandwich.

visual.anchor: a short barrel-shaped cartoon crossing guard woman with a round belly and tiny legs, a huge grey bun of hair, giant mirrored sunglasses, a whistle on a cord
visual.outfit: neon orange safety vest over a blue windbreaker, white gloves
visual.prop: a big blank red octagon paddle, no lettering
